response.sql:
WITH per_race AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, r.name AS race_name, AVG(cr.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(*) AS result_count
  FROM constructorResults cr
  JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId
  WHERE cr.points >= 1.0
  GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name
),
per_name AS (
  SELECT race_name, AVG(avg_points) AS name_avg
  FROM per_race
  GROUP BY race_name
)
SELECT p.raceId, p.race_name, p.avg_points, p.result_count,
       p.avg_points / NULLIF(n.name_avg, 0) AS ratio
FROM per_race p
JOIN per_name n ON n.race_name = p.race_name
ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The race-name average is the unweighted mean of the per-race averages (each race counts equally), as the request states, not a mean over all underlying results.

Races with no constructor results of at least 1.0 points do not appear. A zero name average gives a NULL ratio via NULLIF, and those rows sort last. Ties in ratio are not broken in any particular order.
